page_title: SAS 1-1 BOL | Sassuolo v Bologna 28/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.

90+6' Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his shot flies just over the crossbar. This should be a big warning for the defence.
90+6' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
90+5' Having seen unsporting behavior, Antonio Giua shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) is the recipient.
90+4' The corner from Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) is cleared away by the defence.
90+2' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' What was Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
89' Substitution. Matias Vina will be replaced by Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo).
88' The referee allows time for a substitution. Andrea Pinamonti will be replaced by Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo).
84' Thiago Motta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nikola Moro (Bologna) replacing Oussama El Azzouzi.
83' Sassuolo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
81' The goal by Bologna won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
81' Wait! Referee Antonio Giua has indicated he is going to review the Bologna goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
80' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) finds the back of the net with a superb finish!
79' Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Bologna.
77' Sassuolo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

75' Nice individual effort by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the bottom right corner, but Andrea Consigli does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
73' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
72' Alessio Dionisi has decided to substitute Armand Lauriente and he is replaced by Emil Konradsen Ceide (Sassuolo).
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nedim Bajrami trots off the pitch and is replaced by Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo).
71' Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
69' Substitution. Michel Aebischer makes way for Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna).
68' Bologna hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
63' It's time for a substitution. Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) comes on in place of Charalampos Lykogiannis.
63' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Dan Ndoye (Bologna) replaces Alexis Saelemaekers.
62' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
59' Referee Antonio Giua has finally had enough of Thiago Motta and brandishes a yellow card at him!
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Uros Racic (Sassuolo) comes onto the pitch for Kristian Thorstvedt.
58' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
58' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
57' Close! Martin Erlic (Sassuolo) is a whisker away from finishing-off the move he started. His close-range effort flies just over the bar.
56' The game is interrupted now, Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
52' Sassuolo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
49' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Thiago Motta gives a chance to Stefan Posch (Bologna) and Lorenzo De Silvestri is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

44' 1 - 1 Nice piece of skill by Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo). He perfectly collected a pass from Jeremy Toljan and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:1.
42' Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
39' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) with a wonderful solo effort. He blasted from long range, but the shot towards the bottom left corner was thwarted by Andrea Consigli.
38' Matias Vina (Sassuolo) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
35' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
32' The ball possession is 43:57.
29' Antonio Giua blows his whistle and it's Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
27' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
25' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
25' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
23' Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
20' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
18' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post.
17' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is penalised for a foul. Antonio Giua had a clear view and blows his whistle.
16' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
14' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) gets the ball from a rebound and thumps a terrific long-range shot towards the net. Unfortunately for him, it sails narrowly wide of the left post. Unlucky finish.

13' Matias Vina (Sassuolo) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Lukasz Skorupski!
12' Bologna keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
10' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Riccardo Orsolini with a fine lofted pass.
9' Matias Vina (Sassuolo) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
7' The ball is cleared after Matias Vina (Sassuolo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

3' 0 - 1 Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) weaves his way past several defenders and finds himself in a one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy throws the keeper off balance and he simply puts the ball into the back of net.
2' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
1' The first half has just begun.
Sassuolo will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Antonio Giua.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
